platforms.name: Amazon India
platforms.role: Marketplace; identify the invoice seller separately
instructions: Open Amazon Customer Service while signed into your own account.
Select the relevant order and issue; use chat or the offered callback.
Keep the support reference and save the conversation.

platforms.name: Flipkart
platforms.role: Marketplace; identify the invoice seller separately
instructions: In your own Flipkart account, select Account, Orders, the relevant order, then Help and Chat with us.
Save the complaint reference and replies; interface labels can change.

platforms.name: Blinkit
platforms.role: Identify seller and service provider from order/invoice
instructions: Use order-related chat support inside the Blinkit app.
Preserve product, packaging, label and expiry photographs where relevant.
The official contact page warns that Blinkit has no official customer-care phone line.
Check the current product/category reporting policy promptly; it does not replace statutory rights.
evidence: batch and expiry details for food issues

platforms.name: Instamart
platforms.role: Identify the Instamart contracting entity and invoice seller
instructions: Use order-specific help in your own Instamart app; verify the current interface there.
For escalation, consult the current Instamart-specific grievance entry on the official contact page; do not substitute a privacy or investor contact.
evidence: batch and expiry details where relevant

platforms.name: Agoda
platforms.role: Booking intermediary and property may have different responsibilities
instructions: Open the official Help Center from your booking or your own account.
The authenticated booking workflow has not been independently verified here. Follow the current fields shown there.
Identify the property, contracting entity, booking conditions, payment recipient and country before selecting a formal route.
evidence: alternative accommodation receipt if actually incurred

platforms.name: OYO
platforms.role: Property and booking platform roles require checking
instructions: Use help associated with the booking in your own OYO account.
Detailed authenticated steps and current grievance contacts require verification on the official help/guest-policy pages.
Distinguish property conduct, platform commitments and the payment recipient.
evidence: proof of denied check-in if available

authorities.name: National Consumer Helpline
instructions: Use an available official NCH channel and follow its current registration/submission requirements.
Attach relevant evidence and retain the grievance reference.
This is pre-litigation assistance, not adjudication or a guaranteed remedy.

authorities.name: Consumer Commission preparation
instructions: Verify the current applicable Commission, filing requirements and production-portal instructions.
Prepare parties, chronology, supporting grounds, requested relief and indexed annexures.
Affidavits, verification and any execution requirements must be checked; a draft is not sworn or notarised.

authorities.name: Food Safety Connect
instructions: Consider the official Food Safety Connect route for a food-safety concern; it has a different purpose from a refund grievance.
Preserve packaging, batch/expiry details and photographs. Do not consume suspected unsafe food.
If there are immediate health concerns, seek appropriate medical help rather than waiting for a grievance response.

authorities.name: RBI-regulated service grievance assessment
instructions: First distinguish the merchant dispute from a deficiency by a covered regulated entity.
Verify coverage, prior complaint, applicable scheme version and timing before considering RBI CMS.
A payment made through UPI alone does not establish RBI Ombudsman eligibility.
